verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a $300 free credit for new customers plus always-free usage tiers for select products (google-cloud-docs-12/13/22/30/31), but the evidence never spells out credit expiry (e.g., 90-day window) or the specific per-product limits, leaving the 'limits and expiry spelled out' part of the story unmet. Independent hands-on reports concretely contradict the 'starting is free/safe' framing—accounts suspended with no warning over billing-card issues, and a surprise $30k egress bill cited as killing a startup—showing the free-start experience is not as risk-free as the docs imply. Missing for 10: explicit expiry dates/limits documentation and resolution of the contradicting billing-suspension reports.
